shellCommands.command: cat package.json; ls; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui 2>/dev/null; ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references; rg -n -C 4 -i "chart" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -150
find src __agent_eval__ -type f | head -30; cat src/*.tsx | head -150; cat AGENTS.md | head -30; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'

npm install @gravity-ui/charts 2>&1 | tail -15; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head -40; grep -n '"peerDependencies"' -A8 node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/package.json
npm view @gravity-ui/charts versions --json | tr -d '\n ' | head -c 1500; echo; for v in 1.30.0 1.20.0; do echo $v; npm view @gravity-ui/charts@$v peerDependencies --json; done

npm view @gravity-ui/charts versions --json | tr -d '\n ' | grep -o '"1\.[0-9]*\.[0-9]*"' | tail -3; for v in $(npm view @gravity-ui/charts versions --json | tr -d '\n ' | grep -o '1\.[0-9]*\.[0-9]*' | tail -3); do echo $v; npm view @gravity-ui/charts@$v peerDependencies.@gravity-ui/uikit; done

npm install @gravity-ui/charts@^1.73.0 2>&1 | tail -8; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts; grep -n "Required setup" -i -A15 node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/README.md | head -50
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs && cat INDEX.md | head -60; cat get-started.md | head -80; ls guides; rg -n -i "theme|dark" --glob '*.md' . | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs && cat guides/theming.md | head -80; ls guides/series-types; sed -n 1,60p guides/series-types/line.md 2>/dev/null; cd /home/sandbox/workspace; rg -n "useThemeValue|useTheme\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/*.d.ts | head

.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit SegmentedRadioGroup Card Text 2>&1 | head -30; sed -n 1,50p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/components/SegmentedRadioGroup.md 2>/dev/null | head -5; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit SegmentedRadioGroup Card Text 2>&1 | head -30; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -30; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Card/Card.d.ts | head -30
